name: gh-tasks
description: Browse GitHub issues and Projects from the Codex sidebar and launch tasks from them.

interface.shortDescription: Browse issues & projects, kick off tasks
interface.longDescription: A command center for the GitHub account connected to this machine. Triage issues across every repo, browse Projects as boards, then start a Codex thread pre-loaded with the issue, a plan-first or implement-now brief, and repo context.
